svg.title: Field Methods — Grassland Carbon Workshop
svg.desc: Illustration of a Canadian grassland — bunchgrass tussocks, forbs, sagebrush and scattered open-grown oaks above a deep soil profile threaded with roots, each root system descending from a plant above it — headed "Field Methods".
svg.text: CLIP AND WEIGH • CORING SOIL • SEPARATING ROOTS FROM SOIL
